_readme: Mechanical flaws for BONDED CREATURES -- animal companions and mounts. Spec section 8, D16.
Same shape, same ladder and the same house DCs as flaw_effects.json: the 1st flaw a creature
rolls is minor, the 2nd major, and any further flaw rolls 80% minor / 20% major (flaws.pick_flaws).
Minor-flaw save DCs are always 5, major always 15.
A SEPARATE CATALOGUE, not a filtered view of the PC's 44. Those are written for people --
Alcoholic, Bespectacled, Racial Distrust, Accustomed to Society, Illiterate -- and the subset that
survives on an animal is about eight entries, which every companion would then repeat. These are
written for a body instead: senses, temperament, old injuries, and training that did not take.
Numeric `changes` must use a target companion_stats.apply_modifiers can place (MODIFIER_TARGETS
plus skill.<pf1 id>), because the module strips system.changes off the flaw item and the backend
is the only thing that will ever do this arithmetic. Anything situational is a contextNote --
those reach the sheet as text and are never totalled in.
Gated by Backend/scripts/validate_flaw_effects.py, which sweeps both catalogues.

Skittish.description: Loud noises and sudden movement unsettle the creature. It is easily startled and slow to settle once alarmed.

contextNotes.text: Skittish (minor): when a loud or sudden effect occurs within 30 feet, Will save DC [[5]] or the creature is shaken for 1 round.

Poor Nose.description: The creature's sense of smell is dulled, whether by age, injury or simple bad breeding.

contextNotes.text: Poor Nose (minor): -4 on Perception and Survival checks that rely on scent, and the scent special quality (if any) has half its normal range.

Heavy-Footed.description: The creature moves without any of its kind's usual quiet.

Old Wound.description: A badly healed injury aches in the cold and stiffens after exertion.

contextNotes.text: Old Wound (minor): after any round in which the creature charges or runs, Fortitude save DC [[5]] or it is fatigued for 1 minute.

Picky Eater.description: The creature refuses all but a narrow diet, and sulks when it does not get it.

contextNotes.text: Picky Eater (minor): rations cost double, and after a day without its preferred food the creature takes a -2 penalty on all checks until fed.

Slow to Trust.description: The creature bonded late and still treats strangers as threats.

contextNotes.text: Slow to Trust (minor): -4 on Handle Animal and Charisma-based checks made by anyone other than its master, and it will not willingly be handled by a stranger without a DC [[5]] Will save.

Poor Swimmer.description: Deep water frightens the creature and it flounders in it.

contextNotes.text: Poor Swimmer (minor): Will save DC [[5]] to enter water deeper than its own height voluntarily.

Noisy Breather.description: A narrowed airway makes every breath audible, and hard work audible from further off.

contextNotes.text: Noisy Breather (minor): -4 on Stealth checks while moving at more than half speed, and Fortitude save DC [[5]] to avoid fatigue after a minute of running.

Distractible.description: The creature's attention wanders at exactly the wrong moment.

contextNotes.text: Distractible (minor): Will save DC [[5]] to keep following a command in the round after a new creature comes into view.

Sun-Shy.description: Bright daylight makes the creature squint and shy away.

contextNotes.text: Sun-Shy (minor): -2 on attack rolls and Perception checks in bright light.

Weak Jaw.description: The creature's bite has never had the force its frame suggests.

contextNotes.text: Weak Jaw (minor): -2 on combat maneuver checks made to grapple or maintain a grapple with a natural attack.

Thin-Coated.description: A sparse coat gives the creature little protection from weather.

contextNotes.text: Thin-Coated (minor): -4 on Fortitude saves against cold weather and cold environmental effects; treat any DC [[5]] weather save as one step worse.

One-Eyed.description: The creature lost an eye and has never adjusted to the missing half of its world.

contextNotes.text: One-Eyed (major): the creature has no depth perception -- 20% miss chance against any target further away than 30 feet, and Reflex save DC [[15]] to avoid being flanked from its blind side.

Lame.description: An old break set badly. The creature is sound enough at a walk and useless at a gallop.

contextNotes.text: Lame (major): base land speed is reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5), and the creature cannot run or charge. Fortitude save DC [[15]] after any forced march or it is exhausted.

Ill-Tempered.description: The creature bites first. It has never entirely accepted that anyone outranks it.

contextNotes.text: Ill-Tempered (major): Handle Animal DC increases by 5, and on a failed check by DC [[15]] or more the creature attacks the nearest creature other than its master instead.

Fear of Fire.description: Something burned this creature once and it has not forgotten.

contextNotes.text: Fear of Fire (major): Will save DC [[15]] when a fire larger than a torch comes within 30 feet or the creature is panicked for 1d4 rounds; it will not willingly approach open flame.

Hard of Hearing.description: The creature hears little and reacts late.

contextNotes.text: Hard of Hearing (major): -8 on Perception checks relying on sound, and verbal commands require a DC [[15]] Handle Animal check unless the creature can see the handler.

Brittle Bones.description: The creature's frame is fine-boned and breaks easily.

contextNotes.text: Brittle Bones (major): Fortitude save DC [[15]] on taking falling damage or a critical hit, or the creature is staggered for 1 round.

Glass Stomach.description: The creature's constitution is poor and it sickens easily.

contextNotes.text: Glass Stomach (major): -4 on saves against disease, poison and ingested effects.

Bolts at Blood.description: The smell of blood sends the creature running rather than in.

contextNotes.text: Bolts at Blood (major): the first time each encounter that the creature or its master is reduced below half hit points, Will save DC [[15]] or the creature flees for 1d4 rounds.

Half-Trained.description: The creature's training was rushed and it shows under pressure.

contextNotes.text: Half-Trained (major): the creature knows two fewer tricks than its bonus tricks allow (minimum 0), and Handle Animal checks to push it take a -4 penalty.

Slow Healer.description: Wounds close badly on this creature and infection follows easily.

contextNotes.text: Slow Healer (major): the creature recovers half the normal hit points from natural rest, and magical healing on it is reduced by 1 point per die (minimum 1 per die).
